reviews.description: Jup & Juice interviews MetaDAO co-founder Kollan House about his crypto background, ownership coins, founder control and market-based governance. The publisher’s chapter guide also covers Jupiter DAO, co-founder relationships, rebuilding trust and possible wider uses of futarchy.
reviews.method: Original publisher X post and complete 21-entry chapter guide reviewed
reviews.boundary: Read the original Jup & Juice post and all 21 publisher chapter entries for the 53:06 recording, published January 15, 2026. No full transcript or audio review. Markers identify publisher-listed topics, not independently verified arguments or outcomes. Comparisons with token voting are interview discussion, not proof of futarchy’s superiority. Token-holder and equity-holder rights are a discussion topic, not a legal equivalence. Jupiter DAO’s possible use of futarchy does not establish adoption or a MetaDAO raise. No third-party transcript is republished.

sections.topic: Possible futarchy adoption by Jupiter DAO
